vendor_name: Silonex Inc. (Montreal), the original maker of the NSL-32 family; the line passed to Luna Optoelectronics and then to Advanced Photonix, which publishes it today (vendor/optocoupler/advanced_photonix/NSL-32SR3/, Rev C, which has no chart)
product_page: silonex.com no longer exists; the current product page is Advanced Photonix's (see vendor/optocoupler/advanced_photonix/NSL-32SR3/PROVENANCE.json)
lotto: L47a (la cella del mute: il sostituto della VTL5C4, NC-043)
obtained_by: AI agent (Claude Opus 5.5, bom-component-manager subagent, worktree L47a) on behalf of roberto.carmeli@gmail.com
obtained_from: Downloaded with curl -L from Farnell's document host (www.farnell.com/datasheets/1674205.pdf): a DISTRIBUTOR-HOSTED MIRROR of the manufacturer's datasheet. The page carries the Silonex name, address and document number '104058 Rev 07'. Byte-for-byte as served (HTTP 200, Last-Modified 2012-11-24).
license_notes: Manufacturer-authored datasheet content, redistributed here unmodified for engineering traceability only. Copyright remains with the manufacturer.

files.rename_note: Renamed from the numeric Farnell asset id to a descriptive name. Content unmodified.

why_this_file: It is the only manufacturer document with the 'Photocell Resistance vs. LED Current' chart (log-log, 0.1-100 mA, 10-10000 ohm, five marked points). The Advanced Photonix Rev C has the table only, the Luna Rev 01-04-16 a linear chart that cannot be read below ~1 mA. Source of the static curve above 0.1 mA of models/optocoupler/nsl32sr3_comportamentale.lib (L47a).

what_was_read.page: pagina 1: 'Electrical Characteristics (TA=25C)' e il grafico 'Photocell Resistance vs. LED Current'

key_numbers_transcribed_verbatim.Roff_min: 25 Mohm, 10 sec. after IF = 0, 5Vdc on cell; note (3): measured after 1 minute ON @ IF = 20mA followed by 10 sec. OFF
key_numbers_transcribed_verbatim.rise_time_typ: 5 msec, time to 63% of final conductance @ IF = 5mA
key_numbers_transcribed_verbatim.decay_time_typ: 10 msec, time to 100K after removal of IF = 5mA

what_was_read.chart_read_by_pixel: 300 dpi (pdftoppm), docs/preamp/data/2026-10-02/L47a/nsl32sr3_modello/digit.py: 109 px per decade of resistance, 260 px per decade of current; the five markers at 0.101 mA 2094 ohm, 0.974 mA 300 ohm, 9.82 mA 82.6 ohm, 19.6 mA 62.8 ohm, 38.3 mA 48.8 ohm
what_was_read.note: La tabella (150 ohm tipici a 5 mA) e il grafico (~115 ohm a 5 mA, interpolato) non coincidono: incoerenza del costruttore. Il grafico e' 'typical' senza dispersione.
